estimand.name: sibling_pair_training_labels_unlocked_per_full_endpoint_execution
estimand.population: historical v11 train:b0 lineage-direct sibling graph
estimand.oracle_unit: one complete endpoint execution returning one scalar external grade
estimand.label_closure: an unordered sibling pair becomes labeled if and only if both endpoints have been fully executed

uniform_node.rule: order all endpoints by sha256(seed,NODE,endpoint_id), then fully execute in order

uniform_edge.rule: order all unordered edges by sha256(seed,EDGE,u,v); visit in order and execute only missing endpoints; already closed edges cost zero and are skipped

closure_greedy.rule: repeatedly choose a unique missing-endpoint action induced by an uncovered edge and fitting the remaining maximum budget; maximize exact newly closed edges divided by new endpoint cost, then gain, then lower cost, then sha256(seed,step,sorted missing endpoint ids)

balanced_closure_greedy.rule: as closure_greedy, but maximize gain divided by cost*(1+closed edges in candidate task)*(1+closed edges in candidate run), then unpenalized gain/cost, gain, lower cost, and sha256(seed,step,sorted missing endpoint ids)

aggregate_metrics: parents with at least one closed edge
tasks and physical runs represented by closed edges
maximum single-task and single-run closed-edge share
task and run inverse-Herfindahl effective counts

primary_comparison.uniform_summary: median and nearest-rank 5th/95th percentiles over 64 seeds

promotion_gates.yield: at every headline budget, worst greedy tie seed closed-edge yield is at least 6/5 of the uniform-edge median
promotion_gates.breadth: at every headline budget, worst greedy tie seed task and run breadth are each at least 3/4 of the corresponding uniform-edge median
promotion_gates.anti_dominance: at every headline budget, worst greedy tie seed maximum single-task share is at most 2/5 and maximum single-run share is at most 1/10
promotion_gates.trajectory_consistency: balanced greedy median exceeds uniform-edge median in closed edges at at least 5 of 6 report budgets
